name: 1140-many-mods
about: 600 code mods on at once (N-3008: the loader held 256 and refused the next with Lib.TooManyMods; services, time, events and draw held 512 mods, 256 at a draw point, 1024 textures and 128 fonts): every copy of lt-crowd starts, MR::getRandom(1140, 1140) runs all 600 after hooks (1740), and the last copy watches, draws, makes two textures and takes a font
